name: Iran-Iraq Gas Pipeline (Basra / Shalamcheh line)

values.OtherEnglishNames: Iran-Iraq Gas Pipeline (Basra); Second Iran-Iraq gas export line; Ahvaz-Shalamcheh export line

researcher_notes: MATCH CHECK: existing P5855 'Iran-Iraq Gas Pipeline' (cap 35.00) is the NORTHERN Naft Shahr->Diyala/Baghdad line, NOT this line: its live-sheet row has EndState/Province=Diyala, StartYear=2017 (Baghdad-line first flows June 2017), and ResearcherNotes cite the Diyala crossing (خط ديالى). No existing Iraq gas row covers the Iran->Basra import (P4061 National Gas Pipeline and P7435 Khor Al-Zubair are domestic Iraqi lines; P0450 Iran-Iraq-Syria is a cancelled long-haul). So the second/southern Shalamcheh->Basra export line is genuinely missing = new_row. ADD-THRESHOLD met: (a) sponsor NIGC (National Iranian Gas Co, contract counterparty = Iraq Ministry of Electricity); (b) endpoints Iran (Shalamcheh crossing, Khuzestan) -> Basra, Iraq; (c) concrete step: second gas export contract signed 12 Nov 2015, line operational (flowing) by 2020. CORROBORATION (>=2 independent): (1) euro-petrole 2015-11 (NIGC + Iraq Min. of Electricity sign SECOND export contract, Basra, 7 mcm/d ramping to 20-35, 35 peak in 5 hot months, for power plants); (2) bayancenter.org 2017-12 (Iraqi think-tank; distinguishes نفط شهر/Naft Shahr->Baghdad from الشلامجة/Shalamcheh->Basra, confirms two separate crossings); (3) tehrantimes 2020-04 (Iran exporting 32 mcm/d, obligations cover BOTH Baghdad and Basra = both lines flowing). Independent (Iraqi think-tank, French/English petro portal, Iranian daily). Capacity recorded as contract nominal 25 MMSCMD (~25 mcm/d) ramping to 35 peak. Owner 'National Iranian Gas Co' reuses existing entity (entity_lookup match; NIGC is the exporter/sponsor). LENGTH/DIAMETER: unknown, left blank (no verifiable spec found; not fabricated). First-flows date attributed to mid-2018 by candidate note but no standalone URL verified for exactly 2018, so StartYear left blank; operating status verified via 2020 flows. ROUTE: no verified official GIS; RouteAccuracy=no route (cross-border import, endpoints known but geometry not mapped). Confidence high on existence/sponsor/endpoints/operation; medium on exact capacity units and specs.
